concept: VPC: NAT gateway for outbound access from a private subnet
tests: How to give instances in a private subnet outbound internet access (patches) with no inbound connections.
expected: NAT gateway in a public subnet + a 0.0.0.0/0 route from the private subnet to it. Triggers: "private subnet", "download patches", "cannot receive inbound".
why_not: An IGW route makes the private subnet public; egress-only internet gateway — IPv6 only; VPC peering gives no internet access.
